items.title: Progressive (PGR) Finishes Snapshot Pro Rollout For Commercial Auto Customers
items.summary: Progressive (NYSE:PGR) has completed the rollout of Snapshot Pro, a unified telematics program for commercial auto policyholders. The new platform consolidates the insurer's prior commercial telematics offerings into a single system tailored to business clients. Snapshot Pro supports multiple hardware options, including plug in devices, mobile apps, and certain embedded vehicle technology for fleets.
